title: Hopper FP8 candidate selector and calibration sweeper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a production-ready selector and automated calibration sweeper to safely enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) quantization profiles on Hopper GPUs. The feature should: 1) pick candidate layers/shards and model variants for E4M3 vs E5M2 per-workload, 2) run an automated calibration sweep that exercises sensitivity buckets and produces per-layer scale factors and fallback hints, 3) emit telemetry for stability gates and drift detection, and 4) provide a canary rollout + rollback plan integrated with runtime-1.19. Scope excludes user-facing console UX (handled by PM ticket) but must expose telemetry endpoints consumed by the Console team.
acceptance_criteria: Selector can produce classification: enable-E4M3, enable-E5M2, use-INT8, or force-FP32 per model shard
Automated calibration sweep runs in <= 6 hours for a 175B model on a 16-GPU Hopper pool and produces a human-readable report
Telemetry hooks produced: per-layer sensitivity score, activation outlier rate, drift score and binary pass/fail gating
Canary rollout recipe implemented: shadow-10% -> active-1% -> ramp to 10% with automatic trigger to rollback on regression thresholds
Integration tests and a golden-eval suite show no more than 0.4% relative accuracy regression on held-out prompts for E4M3 profile vs FP32 baseline for curated workloads
Rollback and fallback to INT8/FP32 implemented and exercised in CI with simulated degradation signals
implementation_notes: Design selector as a lightweight deterministic rule engine + learned heuristic (telemetry-based scores). Initial rules derived from per-layer variance and weight magnitude, with heuristics for attention/query/key interaction patterns.

Calibration sweeper will run three passes: seed collection (100k tokens), per-layer scale search (binary and sample-based), and validation (golden prompt set). Use batched micro-calibration to avoid OOM on 16xHopper nodes.
Produce a canonical JSON artifact per run: list of layers, chosen mode (E4M3/E5M2/INT8/FP32), scale params, validation metrics, and suggested runtime gating thresholds.
Telemetry: wire up counters and histograms to existing metrics API; tag by model, shard, quant-profile, and canary-id. Add traces for calibration duration per-shard.
Fallback: runtime will consult artifact at load time and choose mode; if runtime detects >5% token-level anomaly rate for 5 consecutive minutes, it falls back and emits incident metric.
Security: calibration artifacts may contain model fingerprints; mark artifacts as internal and encrypt in S3 with KMS; no plaintext model weights stored by the sweeper service.
test_plan: Unit tests for selector heuristics and edge cases (zero-variance layers, quantization-intolerant ops)
Integration test on canary cluster: run full sweep -> deploy shadow 10% traffic -> run golden evals and latency tests
Regression harness: run against last-golden-seed (ENG-45983) and ensure metric drift < threshold
Stress test: concurrent sweeper runs for 5 large models to validate scheduler fairness and GPU memory limits
Chaos run: inject synthetic activation outliers to verify automatic fallback triggers
